_comment: Tools a project may install with `pin-runner.py install <tool>`. DATA read from the reviewed bus commit, never executed. Add a tool here in the same commit that adds it under tools/factory/.

check-doc-size.purpose: markdown size budgets by role; every tier, glob, exemption and scan mode comes from --config

kernel-subjects.purpose: factory kernel: is a packet a declared kernel subject, declared before its first byte; config from $FACTORY_KERNEL_CONFIG

codex-review.purpose: dispatch one codex exec review with an explicit, recorded model/effort tier

kernel-receipt.purpose: factory kernel: write or dry-run a landing's kernel receipt (a pinned group; install its members first)

kernel-config.purpose: check a project's kernel config with the loader of record (a pinned group; install kernel-subjects first)
